SELECT A.SEQNO SEQNO, A.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, A.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, A.TERM TERM, A.PFLSH PFLSH, A.CREDIT_AMT/100000000 creditAmt, A.VDATE VDATE, A.MDATE MDATE, A.REMARK, A.CREDIT_CONDITION
FROM CREDIT_LINES A where SEQNO = #{seqno,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT A.SEQNO, A.CREDIT_MST_ID creditMstId, A.CUSTOMER_ID customerId, A.CREDIT_AMT/100000000 creditAmt FROM CREDIT_LINES A where PFLSH = #{pflsh,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and PARENT_CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE as id ,y.item_value as name,n.linked_item_code as upperCreditQuoteTypeCode from CREDIT_MST_INFO m inner JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST_LINK n ON m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = n.item_code and m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=n.dict_code left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST y ON m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = y.item_code and m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=y.dict_code where M.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE = '04'
AND (m.CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK <> #{rank,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or m.CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK is null)

select m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE as id ,y.item_value as name,'' as upperCreditQuoteTypeCode from CREDIT_MST_INFO m left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST y ON M.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = y.item_code and m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=y.dict_code where M.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE = '04' AND m.CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK = #{rank,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

with tempce as (select m.seqno as creditMstId,m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE as creditQuoteTypeCode ,y.item_value as creditQuoteTypeValue, DECODE(trim(n.linked_item_code), ' ', 'root', trim(n.linked_item_code)) AS upperCreditQuoteTypeCode from CREDIT_MST_INFO m inner JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST_LINK n ON m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = n.item_code and m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=n.dict_code left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST y ON m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = y.item_code and m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=y.dict_code where M.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE = '04' AND (m.CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK <> #{rank,jdbcType=VARCHAR} or m.CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK is null) union ALL select m.seqno as creditMstId,m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE as creditQuoteTypeCode ,y.item_value as creditQuoteTypeValue,'root' AS upperCreditQuoteTypeCode from CREDIT_MST_INFO m left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST y ON m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE = y.item_code and m.CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE=y.dict_code where M.CREDIT_INFO_TYPE = '04' AND m.CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK =#{rank,jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) select A.creditMstId,A.creditQuoteTypeCode,A.creditQuoteTypeValue,A.upperCreditQuoteTypeCode,(case when count(B.creditQuoteTypeCode) > 0 then '02' else '01' end) as hasChildren ,null as creditAmt from tempce A left join tempce B on A.creditQuoteTypeCode=B.upperCreditQuoteTypeCode GROUP BY A.creditMstId,A.creditQuoteTypeCode,A.creditQuoteTypeValue,A.upperCreditQuoteTypeCode order by creditMstId asc,upperCreditQuoteTypeCode
